what: A 4px rounded accent-color bar under the menu text grows from the center outward, 0 → 100% width in .3s on hover, and folds back to the center on release — 15px between text and bar

options.--fx-gap: Gap between text and bar, default 15px
options.--fx-width: Fully grown width (ratio to text width), default 100% — one reference site uses 50%
options.--fx-color: Bar color, default var(--kf-accent) — for sites using a second accent color (yellow band)
options.--fx-round: Bar corners, default 20px — 0 for a sharp 2px line

from.where: Header row on all pages .l-header__nav a::after (original .l-header__nav ul li a::after — 4px #f8a669 radius 20 · width 0 → 100% · .3s). The site kit does the same thing in shared.css.
shared.css .np-nav > ul > li > a::after (original #globalNav ul li a::after — 2px #ffe000 · width 0 → 50% · transition all .2s · sits under the text)
Header menu and footer menu text (original common.css .global__navi-item a::after: 1px #959595, bottom -2px, scale(0,1) → (1,1) transform .4s, hidden in the phone drawer)
